admission.justification: Without retained evidence a regenerated revision would lose the claims its predecessor made and promote old claims to current.

applicability: Every revision manifest the frame store writes or reads.
conditions: The part map is stored beside the claim map it belongs to.
An all-empty part map is admitted and claims nothing.
exclusions: A revision without parts, whose staleness is whole-page.

evidence: Recorded A3/prior closure; unchanged-source custody and A4 focused preservation controls

statement: The revision the page shows keeps the part map with its claims beside its own claim map, and a manifest refuses a part id declared twice, a part carrying a claim id its revision does not hold, a claim listed twice in one part, a claim in two parts, and — when any part carries claims — a revision claim no part admits.
